subject: FB-3b-judge: review the ON-self-learning KB generation attempt
description: SKILL: self-learn-judge in single-attempt review mode. Review the attempt branch orch/attempt/<FB-3b key> via get_attempt_diff. Apply the code-review rubric to the KB-generation deliverable: (a) did all 5 repos actually onboard and INJECT into the graph (KB updated, not just bundled) — verify via search_knowledge per repo workspace, not just the presence of AGENTS.md files; (b) are the exported <repo>.selflearn.AGENTS.md blocks substantive and non-degenerate (real architectural notes, not empty/boilerplate); (c) scope discipline (only bench/featurebench-kb/ touched, scratch clones/venvs not committed); (d) manifest/README consistency (single ON-self-learning arm). APPROVE (hold-merge) if the KB blocks are real and the graph was updated; KICK BACK (set_status failed + record_decision wired) if any repo produced empty KB, the inject step was skipped, or scratch files leaked into the commit. Never force-merge.
